name: Dixa
description_en:
Dixa combines helpdesk and contact-center channels in a hosted customer-service platform aimed at ecommerce and consumer brands. Team Hub holds conversation and customer context, the Conversation Engine routes work and runs rules, Mim handles selected customer tasks, and AI Co-Pilot assists human agents. They are related capabilities with different entitlements and cost bases.

The evaluation question is whether an incoming order, return or account request reaches the right system and person with the correct context. Mim actions depend on connected tools and policies; a native phone channel is not the same as unlimited free telephony or a fully released voice AI agent. This profile uses public documentation only; no account, migration, call, automation, AI action or bill was tested.
description_zh:
Dixa 在托管客户服务平台中结合帮助台和联络中心渠道，面向电商及消费品牌。Team Hub 保存对话和客户背景，Conversation Engine 路由工作并运行规则，Mim 处理选定客户任务，AI Co-Pilot 辅助人工坐席。它们相关，但权限和成本基础不同。

评估重点是订单、退货或账户请求能否携正确背景到达相应系统和人员。Mim 动作依赖连接工具和政策；原生电话渠道不等于免费无限通信或语音 AI 全量发布。本文仅基于公开文档，未测试账户、迁移、通话、自动化、AI 动作或账单。

core_features.explanation_en: View customer and order context alongside phone, email, chat and social work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在电话、邮件、聊天及社交工作旁查看客户和订单背景。

core_features.explanation_en: Route by skill, language, priority, workload and attributes; AI intent detection is a separately scoped input.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按技能、语言、优先级、工作量及属性路由，AI 意图检测是需明确权限的独立输入。

core_features.name_zh: 按专门流程执行的 Mim 动作
core_features.explanation_en: Use task-specific procedures and connected tools for requests such as tracking or returns, with human escalation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用任务专门流程及连接工具处理查询物流或退货等请求，并可升级人工。

core_features.explanation_en: Build triggers, conditions and actions for tagging, SLA escalation, callbacks and follow-ups.
core_features.explanation_zh: 建立触发器、条件及动作，用于标签、SLA 升级、回拨和跟进。

en: Evaluate a policy-eligible ecommerce return against live order data and a human exception path.
Route multilingual or priority customers to staffed queues while balancing workload.
zh: 依据实时订单数据及人工例外路径，评估符合政策的电商退货。
在平衡工作量的同时，将多语言或优先客户分配至有人值守队列。
use_cases.basis: Editorial scenarios based on vendor descriptions; not customer outcomes or executed tests.

Platform and execution.en: Managed service with a visual Conversation Engine, external customer/order integrations and task-specific Mim procedures. Exact retry, rollback, identity matching and cross-channel billing session boundaries were not established.
Platform and execution.zh: 托管服务，含可视化 Conversation Engine、外部客户／订单集成及 Mim 专门任务流程；准确重试、回滚、身份匹配和跨渠道计费会话边界未确定。

steps.en: Scope channels, real contact reasons, source systems and the human/AI decision boundary with the onboarding team.
steps.zh: 与入门团队明确渠道、真实联系原因、来源系统及人工／AI 决策边界。

steps.en: Pilot one routing path and one order-related procedure with missing data, policy exceptions and unavailable staff.
steps.zh: 使用数据缺失、政策例外及人员不可用情形，试点一个路由及订单相关流程。

steps.en: Confirm the order-form seats, AI rates, add-ons, numbers, telephony and seasonal commitments together.
steps.zh: 一起确认订单合同席位、AI 单价、附加项、号码、通信及季节性承诺。

items.name: Shopify and Magento
items.scope: Mim product page describes live order context/actions; supported store setup, scopes, data mapping and error handling need a scoped demonstration.

items.name: Klaviyo and additional native integrations
items.scope: Named on plan card; exact synchronized objects, cadence and rights were not established.

items.en: Mim voice is marked beta. PDF reading is opt-in for selected agent configurations, rather than a universal attachment-processing guarantee.
items.zh: Mim 语音标为 beta；PDF 阅读需在所选 agent 配置启用，并非所有附件处理都保证支持。

items.en: Promise detection flags gaps between an AI commitment and action; it does not independently prove the external operation completed or recovered.
items.zh: 承诺检测可标记 AI 承诺与动作之间缺口，不能独立证明外部操作已完成或恢复。

pricing.billing_basis: Per-agent plan plus Mim processed-conversation use, eligible seat/usage add-ons, numbers and telephony. Selected billing cycle and order minimums govern final quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Displayed EUR cards: Growth89, Ultimate139, Prime179 per agent/month; monthly/annual switch advertises20% annual saving. Direct current FAQ quotes Mim€0.40 per conversation, including human handoff; legal overage schedule lists€0.60 beyond order limits. These apply in different scopes and are not combined into one universal rate. No self-serve free trial.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 显示欧元卡：Growth每坐席每月89、Ultimate139、Prime179；月／年切换宣传年付节省20%。当前直接读回 FAQ称 Mim每对话€0.40，包含转人工；法律超额表列订单限制之外€0.60。适用范围不同，未合成为通用单价。无自助免费试用。

faq.question_en: Is Mim usage free because the AI Agent is included?
faq.question_zh: 包含 AI Agent 就表示 Mim 用量免费吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Pricing says Mim is available in plans and separately billed per conversation, while Co-Pilot/QA and voice-related charges have other bases. The signed order determines the actual commitment.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。定价称套餐可用 Mim，但另按对话收费；Co-Pilot／QA及语音相关费用采用其他基础。实际承诺由签署订单确定。

faq.question_en: Does native phone mean voice AI is fully released?
faq.question_zh: 原生电话表示语音 AI 已全面发布吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The platform includes phone/contact-center features; the current Mim page separately marks voice beta. Confirm the requested AI voice path and region.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。平台含电话／联络中心功能，当前 Mim 页面另将语音标为 beta，需确认所需 AI 语音路径及地区。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Start from the customer task and source order
sections.title_zh: 从客户任务及来源订单开始
sections.en:
Team Hub brings previous conversations, orders and customer context to human support. Mim is described as using live information and task-specific procedures for tracking, returns, cancellations and order changes. A useful demonstration starts with a known test order and an explicit allowed change; a conversation transcript is not the authoritative fulfillment or payment record.

Inspect identity matching when the customer uses another channel, and compare the final statement with the backend order. Do not infer a verified refund from a confident answer. Claimed containment, staffing savings, CSAT and setup speed are vendor evidence only, without a benchmark in this research.
sections.zh:
Team Hub 把历史对话、订单及客户背景提供给人工支持。Mim 被描述为采用实时信息及任务专门流程处理物流、退货、取消及订单改动。演示可从已知测试订单和明确允许改动开始；对话记录不是权威履约或支付记录。

客户使用另一渠道时应检查身份匹配，把最终回复与后端订单对照，不能由自信回答推断退款已验证。自助解决、减少招聘、CSAT及配置速度等声明仅为厂商证据，本文没有基准测试。

sections.title_en: Define routing rules and treat AI intent as a fallible input
sections.title_zh: 定义路由规则，并将 AI 意图视为可能出错的输入
sections.en:
The routing page names skills, language, priority, workload and custom attributes such as customer value. AI intent detection adds a message-derived signal for choosing a queue or automation. Plans distinguish basic routing from skills, external-data and advanced intent capabilities; a broad routing headline does not establish every edition’s rights.

For a hypothetical damaged-order case, route by market, urgency and available expertise, then test an unknown language, misclassified intent, missing customer attribute and no available specialist. A fallback should leave the request owned and visible. These are proposed checks; exact queue precedence, race handling and retry semantics were not verified.
sections.zh:
路由页列出技能、语言、优先级、工作量和客户价值等自定义属性。AI 意图检测增加从消息推导的信号，用于选择队列或自动化。套餐区分基本路由、技能、外部数据及高级意图能力；宽泛路由标题不能确定每版权限。

以假设订单损坏事项为例，按市场、紧急度及可用专长路由，再测试未知语言、意图误分类、客户属性缺失和无可用专员。兜底应让请求有归属且可见。这些是建议检查，准确队列优先级、竞争处理及重试语义未验证。

sections.title_en: Use procedures and handoff for exceptions
sections.title_zh: 以专门流程及交接处理例外
sections.en:
The current Mim page describes an orchestrator selecting focused procedures with only the instructions and tools needed for each task. It also describes handoff with the conversation, attempted actions, order/customer context and escalation reason, including an explanation outside opening hours. That describes an operating model rather than guaranteeing every connector or policy exception is safe.

Test a policy-ineligible return, unavailable order system and customer asking for a person. Compare generated promises with the actual action result. Promise detection is said to flag unfulfilled commitments; flagging does not restore a failed backend operation. PDF reading is opt-in, and voice is marked beta, so neither should be silently treated as universal production capability.
sections.zh:
当前 Mim 页描述编排器选择聚焦流程，每个任务只携带所需指令和工具；也描述转交时附带对话、尝试动作、订单／客户背景和升级原因，非工作时间解释后续安排。这是运行模型说明，不能保证每个连接器或政策例外安全。

应测试不符合政策的退货、订单系统不可用及客户要求人工，并把生成承诺与实际动作结果对照。承诺检测据称会标记未履行事项，但标记不能恢复失败后端操作。PDF 阅读需选择启用，语音标为 beta，不应自动当成普遍生产能力。

sections.title_en: Keep automation, human assistance and quality measures distinct
sections.title_zh: 区分自动化、人工辅助及质量指标
sections.en:
The visual builder describes triggers, conditions and actions for routing, tagging, SLA escalation, acknowledgements and scheduled follow-ups. AI enrichment can extract an order number or contact reason before assignment. Co-Pilot is human assistance, while Mim is customer-facing task execution; buying one does not establish the complete cost or rights of the other.

A pilot should inspect an updated tag that also triggers another rule, a scheduled follow-up after a human takeover and a near-breach request. Compare underlying conversations with self-service, transfer, resolution and QA measures rather than equating them. Full conflict handling, audit retention, rollback and recovery procedures were not established from these public pages.
sections.zh:
可视化构建器描述路由、标签、SLA 升级、确认回复及定时跟进的触发器、条件和动作。AI 增强可在分配前提取订单号或联系原因。Co-Pilot 是人工辅助，Mim 则面向客户执行任务；购买其中之一不能确定另一项完整成本或权限。

试点应检查更新标签又触发另一规则、人工接手后的定时跟进及接近违约的请求。应把自助、转交、解决和 QA 指标与原对话对照，不能等同。公开页未确定完整冲突处理、审计保留、回滚及恢复程序。

sections.title_en: Separate the seat commitment from AI and communication usage
sections.title_zh: 区分席位承诺、AI 及通信用量
sections.en:
The pricing page displays Growth €89, Ultimate €139 and Prime €179 per agent/month with monthly/annual controls, and a current direct FAQ quote of €0.40 per Mim conversation, whether resolved or handed to a representative. The legally published overage list, effective October 2025, separately lists €0.60 per Mim conversation beyond order limits. These rates have different scopes; no single normalized all-purpose AI rate is asserted.

The terms make the signed minimum commitment the billing baseline, which cannot be reduced during the term regardless of usage. Add-ons, number subscriptions, telephony/SMS and BYOC can add charges; included native channels do not mean free carrier usage. No numeric minimum seat count is established, and the public page says there is no self-serve trial. Confirm the selected cycle, contract rate, overage, seasonal seats, implementation and exit/export conditions together. Proprietary service rights are documented; hosting selection, exact exports/restore, complete UI languages and regional purchasing remain unverified.
sections.zh:
定价页显示 Growth每坐席每月€89、Ultimate€139、Prime€179，并有月／年控制；当前直接读回 FAQ报价 Mim每对话€0.40，无论解决或转人工。2025年10月生效法律超额表另列订单限制之外每 Mim对话€0.60。这些单价适用范围不同，本文不设单一通用 AI 归一化价格。

条款把签署最低承诺作为账单基线，无论实际用量均不能在期内减少。附加项、号码订阅、电话／短信及 BYOC 可增加费用，原生渠道包含不表示运营商免费。未确定数值最低席位，公开页称无自助试用。应一起确认周期、合同价、超额、季节席位、实施及退出／导出条件。专有服务权限有文档，但托管选择、准确导出／恢复、完整界面语言及地区购买未核实。

What is native phone versus voice AI beta?

research_gaps.en: No account, migration, identity match, flow, call, AI action or billing tested. Selected cycle, order price/minimums, voice beta availability, overage applicability, provider costs, regions, export/restore and full UI languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、迁移、身份匹配、流程、通话、AI 动作或账单。所选周期、订单价／最低量、语音 beta 可用性、超额适用、服务商成本、地区、导出／恢复及完整界面语言未核实。

research_gaps.en: Direct current marketing rate and dated legal overage rate differ in scope. Confirm signed rates, minimums and usage definitions rather than assuming unlimited free AI.
research_gaps.zh: 当前营销价与有日期法律超额价适用范围不同，应确认签署单价、最低量及用量定义，不能假定 AI 无限免费。
